title: High-dimensional limits for reflected Brownian motion in the orthant
summary: We study interacting Brownian particles on the half-line whose interaction occurs through boundary local times at the origin. The particle system is given by \[ X_i^n(t)=X^n_{0,i}+W_i^n(t)+L_i^n(t) +\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{j\ne i}ρ^n_{ij}L_j^n(t), \qquad i\in[n],\ t\ge0, \] where the initial conditions are exchangeable, the driving Brownian motions $W_i^n$ are i.i.d., and $L_i^n$ denotes the boundary local time of $X_i^n$ at zero.
